submission.justification: Crystal-K1 at 6 cm gives the best simulated energy resolution at 662 keV of the candidates, 4.308% FWHM. Its intrinsic background is 0.3 counts/kg/day, within the 0.5 counts/kg/day budget, so it is suitable for low-background operation. Crystal-K2 is excluded because its intrinsic background (2 counts/kg/day) exceeds the budget. Crystal-K3 has the lowest background (0.1) but its best resolution is 8.528% FWHM, roughly twice K1's, so it does not meet the resolution goal. Across the K1 thickness scan, 4 cm gave 4.519%, 5 cm 4.477%, 5.5 cm 4.337%, 6 cm 4.308%, 8 cm 5.081% and 10 cm 6.491%, so 6 cm is the optimum of the tested points.
